Chevron's average quarterly cost of revenue in fiscal 2025 was about **$27.05 billion**. This rests on one assumption, because Chevron's income statement has no line called "cost of revenue."

I used "Purchased crude oil and products" as the closest match. Chevron's FY2025 10-K shows purchased crude oil and products of $108,214 million for 2025.

$108,214 million ÷ 4 quarters = about $27,053.5 million per quarter.

If you meant a broader definition that also includes operating, selling, general and administrative expenses ($33,131 million), the figure would be higher. I didn't compute that version.
